note: Exact identities (row count and SHA-256 of dev_pips.csv) of the physical device graphs that ordinary builds emit when a graph-changing option is set. Keyed by the shared-control marker, the routing admission and the sorted option set; see special_routes.GRAPH_PROFILE_OPTIONS. Regenerate and check with qualification/regen_physical_graph_profiles.py after any reviewed graph change. The base graphs and their historical snapshots stay pinned in special_routes.py.
